description: React component for verifying user's phone number via OTP, including sending OTP, handling user input, and updating user verification status.

methods.name: onOtpError
methods.description: Handles errors during OTP sending, displays error messages.

methods.name: onOtpCompleted
methods.description: Handles successful OTP send completion, shows success message.

methods.name: onUpdateUserError
methods.description: Handles errors during user update, displays error messages.

methods.name: onUpdateUserCompleted
methods.description: Handles successful user update, shows success message.

methods.name: onCodeFilled
methods.description: Handles OTP code input, verifies code, updates user verification status, and navigates back.

methods.name: resendOtp
methods.description: Generates a new OTP and triggers resend.

methods.name: handleCode
methods.description: Handles OTP input change, triggers verification when 6 digits entered.
